headline: US Ends Syria Terror Designation After 47 Years
caption:
The United States ended Syria's 47-year designation as a State Sponsor of Terrorism on Monday, clearing the way for legal US arms sales and export financing. Congress still controls separate Caesar Act sanctions the delisting does not affect.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Venezuela Quake Toll Tops 6,500
caption:
Venezuela's earthquake death toll has passed 6,509, with 226,696 people treated for injuries since June, Assembly Speaker Jorge Rodríguez said. More than 25,000 homes were damaged and 1,500 aftershocks recorded.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Leaderless Online Movement Forces Minister's Resignation
caption:
A leaderless online youth group in New Delhi has forced a minister's resignation and is calling supporters back to the streets on September 5 to test whether the concession holds. Parents of NEET exam victims will lead the march from India Gate to Delhi Police Headquarters.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Military Cargo Plane Lands in Moscow
caption:
A US military C-17 landed in Moscow Tuesday after flying direct from Riga, days after leaving a base tied to presidential air travel. Russia says it has no information on the flight's purpose or passengers.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Declares Hormuz Clear, No Reopening Confirmed
caption:
Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz clear, but Iran has not confirmed it and a tanker was struck Monday. Insurers, not navies, will decide when cargo actually moves again.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Syria's Kurdish-led SDF Dissolves Into National Army
caption:
Syria's SDF dissolved itself, transferring conscription, courts and prisons across the northeast to Damascus under a March merger completing tens of thousands of fighters into the national army. The fate of roughly 10,000 ISIS detainees the SDF guarded remains unaddressed.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Nvidia Is Now Backing $230 Billion in Buyer Debt
caption:
Nvidia is backstopping $230 billion in customer lease obligations, absorbing losses if buyers like CoreWeave fail to pay, BofA Securities says. Analysts plan to press Nvidia on reserve buffers when it reports earnings Wednesday.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: State Grants National Honor to Secure Starlink Access
caption: Kyiv offered Elon Musk a state honor to secure Starlink access, whose terminals one man can switch off or restrict at will. Musk has called Ukrainian strikes on Russian territory via Starlink an escalation. Full story in the app — link in bio.
